canonical_project: SK Group AI data center (Nghe An)
owner: SK Group (SK Innovation) with National Innovation Center (NIC) and Nghe An provincial authorities
notes: Tuoi Tre reports SK Group signed MOUs with Nghe An province and NIC to develop an AI data center in Nghe An, linked to the Quynh Lap LNG power project (1.5GW) for which SK Innovation is studying power/energy solutions. Early-stage MOU, capacity not disclosed.
